plain_cause: SB3 SubprocVecEnv is synchronous. It waits for the slowest solver worker every RL step. DR-ALNS move times have heavy tails, so most workers wait while one seed/instance finishes. This destroys throughput before PPO can learn.
not_the_cause: Not a solver semantic issue, not worker environment drift, not a PPO-quality result. The PPO pilot did not reach valid episode data.
recommended_next_fix: Replace synchronous VecEnv sampling with an asynchronous episode collector, or switch first to an offline/contextual bandit controller using completed ALNS block traces. Do not run longer SB3 synchronous PPO in this setup.
